detector.name: OpenAI  -  Sudden change in operation duration sum
detector.programText:
from signalfx.detectors.against_recent import against_recent
AB = alerts(detector_name='OpenAI Operation Duration Detector').publish(label='AB')
AD = alerts(detector_name='OpenAI  -  Operation Duration Detector').publish(label='AD')
A = histogram('gen_ai.client.operation.duration', filter=filter('gen_ai.system', 'openai')).sum().publish(label='A')
against_recent.detector_mean_std(stream=A, current_window='10m', historical_window='1h', fire_num_stddev=3.5, clear_num_stddev=3, orientation='above', ignore_extremes=True, calculation_mode='vanilla').publish('Sudden change in operation duration sum')

rules.description: All the values of gen_ai.client.operation.duration in the last 10m are more than 3.5 standard deviation(s) above the mean of its preceding 1h.
rules.detectLabel: Sudden change in operation duration sum
